text: AI Platform Intern at Northstar Labs. Built FastAPI services for LLM agent workflows, including tool selection, structured JSON outputs, and execution trace logging. Added pytest coverage for parser, matcher, and report generation modules.

Backend Developer at FitFlow. Integrated OpenAI API into a coaching platform, validated structured model responses, and implemented fallback template generation when model calls failed. Dockerized the backend development environment.

CareerAgent project. Built an Agentic RAG backend for technical job matching with JD parsing, resume parsing, BM25 retrieval, embedding vector search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, optional reranking, skill gap analysis, risk auditing, and Markdown report generation.

Agent Tool Trace Demo. Implemented a controller that routes user requests to parser, retriever, project auditor, and plan generator tools. Stored each tool call with input, output, latency, and error status for debugging.
Skills summary: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Docker, Pytest, OpenAI API, embeddings, BM25, hybrid search, RAG, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval evaluation.

Machine Learning Engineer Intern at DocSearch. Built a document question answering prototype using embeddings, chunking, vector similarity search, and answer generation over policy documents. Focused on retrieval quality and prompt formatting.
Data Science Assistant at Campus Analytics. Cleaned student support data with pandas, trained scikit-learn classifiers, and created dashboards for error analysis and performance reporting.

Policy QA RAG project. Implemented chunking, sentence-transformer embeddings, vector retrieval, and citation-style evidence snippets for a question answering demo. Did not include autonomous tool selection or MCP tools.
Resume Matcher baseline. Compared job description skills with resume skills using keyword extraction and cosine similarity. Generated a simple skill gap report without retrieval evaluation metrics.
Skills summary: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, sentence-transformers, embeddings, vector retrieval, prompt engineering, data visualization.

Backend Engineer Intern at ShopGrid. Built FastAPI endpoints for product search, user profiles, and order processing. Added PostgreSQL schemas, request validation, API documentation, Docker Compose setup, and integration tests.
Software Developer at University Lab. Implemented authentication middleware, background jobs, logging, and REST API error handling for an internal scheduling system.
Fitness Tracking API. Developed a FastAPI backend for workouts, user profiles, and progress analytics. Used Docker, PostgreSQL, Pydantic validation, and pytest for service tests.
Inventory Management Service. Designed CRUD APIs, pagination, role-based access control, and database migrations. No LLM, retrieval, or agent workflow was implemented.
Skills summary: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, REST API design, Pydantic, pytest, GitHub Actions, logging, backend debugging.
Computer Vision Research Assistant. Trained semantic segmentation models on remote sensing imagery using U-Net and ResNet encoders. Evaluated IoU distributions and visualized segmentation masks.
Robotics Project Developer. Built TurtleBot3 perception and navigation workflows with ROS2, OpenCV, LiDAR processing, mapping, localization, and waypoint navigation.
Traffic Sign Mask R-CNN project. Implemented object detection and instance segmentation for traffic signs using PyTorch, OpenCV, Mask R-CNN, NumPy, pandas, and matplotlib.
Dead Tree Segmentation System. Built an improved U-Net model with RGB and NIR inputs for satellite imagery segmentation. Used BCE and Dice loss and analyzed mIoU results.
Skills summary: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Mask R-CNN, U-Net, ResNet, ROS2, LiDAR, computer vision, image segmentation.
AI Developer Intern at BrightApps. Worked on several AI features and helped improve user experience. Participated in meetings about LLM strategy and wrote small Python scripts for data cleanup.
Junior Web Developer at Local Studio. Built React pages, connected forms to backend APIs, fixed CSS issues, and collaborated with designers on user interface improvements.

LLM Assistant concept. Claimed to use RAG, agents, MCP, and vector databases, but project notes only describe a chat UI mockup and generic prompt examples. No retrieval code, tool execution, or evaluation is documented.
Portfolio Website. Created a personal portfolio using React and Vite with project cards, responsive styling, and contact form validation.
Skills summary: Python, React, LLM, RAG, agents, MCP, vector databases, prompt engineering, FastAPI. Several advanced AI skills are listed without detailed supporting project evidence.
